4K image generation in 10 seconds! ⚡

Meet MiniMax H3-Image.

16 million pixel resolution. Stunning realism. Precise prompt following & editing. Up to 16 reference images. All in 10 seconds.

And it's open-weight. 🚀

Available now via our API, MiniMax Code, and Hailuo AI — with 50% off 16MP+ generations during launch week!

Can't wait to see what you create. 🔥
